fusions.name: Hauled Onto the Coals
fusions.desc: Casts a 5-tile line of red-hot barbs ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Left In
fusions.desc: A barbed strike that deals 7 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Reel In
fusions.desc: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds. A ring of flame fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Snag
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
